text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tough confrontation between Prime Minister Netanyahu and Finance Minister Meridor over reform package.
- Rise of 5.6 percent in number of job seekers in September versus August.
- Netanyahu, Palestinian President Arafat summit likely.
- King Hussein of Jordan: Peace process still in jeopardy.
- Israeli President Weizman to meet Egyptian President Mubarak today.
- Iran could begin manufacturing nerve gas in a year.
- Crisis in Scitex: hundreds to be laid off in Scitex reforms to be announced today.
- Weizman: I am going to Egypt to strengthen peace.
- Housing Ministry says that in few years there will be Arab majority in Haifa area.
- Israeli member of World Economic Forum organising Cairo economic conference set for November said it would be better if it were delayed given existing political atmosphere.
- Nestle interested in share in Yotvata dairy concern.
